pr_title: *: use tidb version to decide insert internal DDL into queue or table
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: xiongjiwei <xiongjiwei1996@outlook.com>

<!--

Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

Please create an issue first to describe the problem.

There MUST be one line starting with "Issue Number:  " and 
linking the relevant issues via the "close" or "ref".

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

-->

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/36761
close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/36659

Problem Summary:

if all tidbs in the cluster exit abnormal, e.g. fatal error during the upgrade and restart, the owner key will not be cleared. Then the restarted tidb thinks there is an owner with the old version tidb so that it will add the ddl job into the queue, but in fact, all tidbs are the newer version which runs with concurrent ddl, so the internal ddl will not be run and all instances are hanged.

to solve this problem, we make the internal ddl has a timeout, the tidb will exit if timeout. Once it restarts, it has a chance to handle it properly

### What is changed and how it works?

## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

install tidb cluster with v5.4.2 version
upgrade to v6.2.0 version


### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
upgrade successfully

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
upgrade fail

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

[root@tidb-0 bin]# ./tidb-server -V       
Release Version: v6.2.0
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 1f14f4cf8b1954cf28cc75a9577b13563a733cc4
Git Branch: heads/refs/tags/v6.2.0
UTC Build Time: 2022-07-31 10:09:53
GoVersion: go1.18.2
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: 6.2.0-alpha
Check Table Before Drop: false
Store: unistore

if  binlog.ignore-error= true， upgrade will successfully. 
most of the customer clusters set   binlog.ignore-error= true, so degrade the severity to major

the error can be ignored because `isConcurrentDDL` is only used here and if in `inBootstrap` we shall always think `isConcurrentDDL` is false, So that the error does not matter
We can filter the jobs in advance, so that the number of SQLs could be reduced to 1.

I think it is ok, the ddl should not be a huge number, just more insert SQL is fine and the code is easy to understand.
